title: Aromatic Asian Chinese Pork Dim Sum
description: A flexitarian-friendly Chinese dish featuring pork and thai-bird-chili, served in a dim sum form and grilled to perfection on a robata grill, perfect for a lazy Sunday
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, sliced thai bird chili, grated ginger, and minced garlic
Mix well until all the ingredients are fully incorporated
Add the soy sauce and sesame oil to the bowl and mix until the pork mixture is well coated
Lay a wonton wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal the dim sum
Repeat the process with the remaining wrappers and pork mixture
Grill the dim sum on the robata grill for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred
Serve the dim sum hot, garnished with chopped scallions
